name: Hazakura Seiso
source: Hazakura Seiso is one of the 4 clones of the Bushido Plan. Who she is a clone of is known to nobody including herself, except for a few important people at Kuki Corp. She transferred to 3-S class. She also has a customized bike made by the Kuki Family which she rides to school in the morning.
